text:
julian: Quick question — can I share the design doc with an external design agency for a UX pass? The doc has screenshots of flows that currently show masked emails (a***@example.com) and hashed user IDs. It's an NDA partner.

maria: Do the screenshots contain any raw PII (full emails, phone numbers, postal addresses) or just masked/hashed values?

julian: Mostly masked emails and hashed IDs. A couple of screens display "first initial + last" (e.g., J. Smith) and a settings page that lists an IP hint in a non-obvious field. No session tokens or raw logs.

sec-bot: Automated check: External sharing of data classified as 'Restricted' requires an explicit Security Approval + EAA. See /policies/data-sharing. This is an automated reminder.

olivia: NDA helps but doesn't replace the need for minimization. Partial names + masked emails can still be identifying in small customer sets. Recommend pseudonymize or synthetic users where possible.

alex: If you can generate a sanitized copy (fake accounts, same UI states) that's the safest route. Otherwise: (1) replace hashes with deterministic fake IDs, (2) mask names fully, (3) strip IP hints.

julian: Ok — I can make a sanitized build. Quick question: is replacing names with initials and changing hashed ids to fake uuids enough, or do we need to remove the masked email strings entirely?

maria: Checklist for approval: 1) No full emails/phones/addresses; 2) All real user IDs replaced with synthetic values; 3) No logs or IPs in screenshots; 4) Upload to secure S3 with a time-limited link and reviewer ACL; 5) Add a short note in the doc that it's sanitized. If all true, security can sign off in-thread.

sam: Also add a single-line comment in the doc header: "Sanitized for external review — no live PII" for auditability.

maria: Ping me here once uploaded. I'll do a quick check and +1 or request further redaction. :thumbsup:

julian: Thanks — will scrub names & ids and upload to s3://redwood-external-reviewers/ux-sanitized/ with 72h expiry. Posting link in ~1hr and will @maria @olivia.

olivia: Perfect. I'll focus on checking re-identification risk after upload. If anything looks borderline I'll flag.
